name: WhoisDS newly registered domains (free daily list)
operator: WhoisDS.com (commercial WHOIS and newly-registered-domain data vendor)
tier_rationale: Identifiable commercial data vendor with published terms of use, a pricing page and a multi-year public track record; P005 chair: 'Tier community for the WhoisDS list operator; no value is sent.' The list is only downloaded (dataset): no investigated value ever reaches the operator.

reliability.justification: Free daily sample of newly registered names (capped at 70,000 names per day on 2026-11-26, gTLDs plus some ccTLDs, names 24-48 h old at publication): presence is a strong signal, absence proves nothing.

nrd_daily.title: WhoisDS free daily newly-registered-domains zip (domain-names.txt, last 4 list dates)

terms.quote: The data provided below is daily list of Newly Registered Domains without whois database downloaded free of charge; except where otherwise stated, they may be reused, including for commercial purposes, without a license and without any payment.

nrd_daily.notes: Research C0022, re-verified on the listing page 2026-11-26 (quote above). Download URL https://www.whoisds.com//whois-database/newly-registered-domains/{base64('YYYY-MM-DD.zip')}/nrd; the free page keeps the last 4 list dates (a date outside that window answers HTTP 200 text/html with an empty body). One dataset per list date (registered as whoisds_nrd.YYYY-MM-DD), fetched by `v3lum data update` only and matched locally by nrd_feeds (P005): the lists are never redistributed (terms of use: 'NO REDISTRIBUTION: You may NOT redistribute our data to other parties'). No ETag/Last-Modified: no conditional GET.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-1 (P005 nrd_feeds). Dataset-only provider: nothing is sent but the static list URL. min_interval 1.5 s between list downloads; max_bytes 50 MB (P005 cond 6 uncompressed cap; the zip is about 0.6 MB).
